page.title: Kog'Maw ADC: where Riot is taking him

items.text: Kog'Maw ADC · where Riot is taking him

Every change in the LoL wiki patch history, V1.0 to V26.22.
Stats: u.gg NA 26.22, coachless NA Diamond+ 16.22.
Pulled 2026-11-23. Patch notes say what changed,
not why: the "direction" is my read.

Peaked at 7% twice, trimmed back to 6% each time.
Flat since 2023.

Only ever goes down. The free attack speed in his
kit is shrinking.

Only ever goes up. Three raises, the last two in
2025.
Untouched for nine years, then +50% in 25.17.
Up twice. 25.17 made it grow with rank.

Cut in 25.04 while the AP ratio went up: flat power
moved into scaling.

Green rings are raises, red rings are
cuts.

The on-hit numbers get pulled back: W
%HP returns to 6% every time it rises,
and Q attack speed only goes down.

The AP numbers (Q, W and R ratios) only
go up, and three of those raises landed
in 2025.

Q base damage fell in the same patch its
AP ratio rose: Riot moved flat power
into scaling.

Launch kit: armor pen Q, stacking artillery R. Riot mostly
tuned R spam (stack caps, mana).

The rework years. W becomes %HP + range (5.22), attack speed
moves to Q (6.19), R gets its execute (6.21).

Base stat fixes (7.22, 8.11, 12.10). AP ratios up (10.13,
11.18). W %HP rides 5–7%.

Safety buffs (passive, E, Q feel) while W and Q shred are
trimmed.

The AP era: Q, W and R AP ratios raised, Q base and attack
speed cut.
Every gameplay change, V12.22 to V26.22
▲ buff   ▼ nerf   ◆ mixed, for Kog's power. Bug fixes left out.
Passive: 140 to 650 damage (from 125 to 550), now ghosted
Q cooldown 8 to 7 s. E mana 60 to 40 at rank 1
Passive +10% move speed. E slow 40–60%. Q cast = attack windup
Q shred 23–31% to 16–32%: weaker early, a bit stronger at rank 5
Q base 90–290 to 80–260, AP ratio 70% to 80%
Q 90% AP, W +1.5% HP per 100 AP, R up to 45% AP
W fixed to act as a normal on-hit effect (26.10: procs Statikk Shiv)
Base MR 30 to 33, growth 1.3 to 1.1 (same at 15, less late)

Up. Base damage traded for AP scaling, then AP
buffed outright.
Down. Q attack speed cut twice, W %HP held at 6%.
Small buff. R AD ratio once (14.5).
Up in 2023–24: passive, E slow, Q feel.

Left alone. Only clean-ups since the 12.10
durability patch.

My read: Riot wants Kog to be a scaling carry
who earns his damage from AP and items, not from
free attack speed and flat lane damage in his kit.
AP Kog got the raises. On-hit was held in place.

Rank 5 Q and W, rank 3 R, before 25.04 vs now, from the patch
history. AP only (AD parts left out). R is the minimum hit (target
above 60% HP); it doubles below 40% HP.

Q now hits weaker than in 2024 until you
have about 150 AP (roughly one AP item), and
harder after.

W is the big one: +1% of their max HP on
every attack at 200 AP, +2% at 400. That is
the part of AP Kog that kills tanks.

So the AP build lost a little lane damage
and gained a lot of item-scaling damage.
On-hit got none of this.
u.gg, NA, patch 26.22: who goes AP?
Buckets overlap (Diamond+ includes Master+). Raw win rates.

The higher the rank, the more AP.
Stormraider's: 7% → 21% → 34% → 59% of games.
Challenger is the only bucket that starts Doran's Ring most.
Same shape on 26.21 (Stormraider's 7 / 25 / 38 / 58%).

WPA = win rate minus the average pre-game win probability, in points. Buys
are item purchases. At 1,000 buys the 95% noise on a win rate is about ±3
points, so every gap here is a lean.

Green = AP item, sepia = on-hit.
No item or keystone is clear of the noise.
Press the Attack (134 picks) and Stormsurge (145)
are the smallest samples.
Your rule holds for his abilities

Base damage cut (Q 25.04, E 14.23), AP ratios raised (Q, W, R). His
base stats were not nerfed: only durability clean-ups.

Doran's Ring, Dusk and Dawn, then Shadowflame or Rabadon's,
Sorcerer's. Stormraider's Surge. Weaker than 2024 before ~150 AP,
stronger after. Best into squishy teams and short fights.

W stays at 6% and Q attack speed was cut twice, so the attack speed
has to come from items. Doran's Bow, Rageblade, then Terminus or
BotRK, Lethal Tempo. Best into tanks and long fights.
Play the curve, not just the items

Less flat damage in the kit means a weaker lane before the first item.
As AP, trade with E and Q but take the big fights after your first
back. Level 1 to 3 pressure is still the Bow and Lethal Tempo version.
Honest verdict: a small change, not a rebuild

The data does not split the builds: every gap is inside the noise.
Higher ranks lean AP, which fits Riot's direction. So: AP by default
in Master+ lobbies with squishy enemies, on-hit into tanks. The climb
is still positioning and VODs, not this.

Re-check this page when Riot next touches W's %HP,
Q's attack speed or any AP ratio: those are the dials.

source.note: u.gg NA patch 26.22 (URL 16_22), the latest full patch. 26.23 had 30 NA Diamond+ Kog games on 2026-11-23, too few. coachless NA Diamond+ 16.22. Patch notes say what changed, not why. Everything under 'direction' is inferred from the pattern of changes. Kog's own page also leaves out item and system changes (Doran's Bow, boots, on-hit items), which move his builds as much as his own numbers do.
